summary: Frontend-only regression for the Ferrari-hair bug fix. Loaded homepage, toggled all 3 team themes (Ferrari/McLaren/Mercedes), validated hotspots + heart card hover-expand, and pressed ArrowDown to confirm Silverstone circuit view mounts. Ferrari braided cornrow hair is now visible on top of the head (zoomed screenshot + pixel sampling confirm ~22.5% dark pixels in the head region, not bald/clipped).
critical_code_review_comments: HeroStage.jsx uses layout.ratio (536/1139) matching the re-processed Ferrari asset - hair now renders. Mercedes ratio 538/1186 and McLaren 751/1222 are also correct.
Minor: onPointerMove on hero section runs every mouse move without throttling; fine for now but could be RAF-batched for perf.
Minor: framer-motion `useSpring` created per-render inside component is OK, but consider memoizing HOTSPOT_CONTENT/LAYOUTS (already module-scope constants - good).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ferrari image at /app/frontend/public/images/lewis-ferrari.png is 536x1139 with braided hair preserved. Pixel-sampling helper in playwright script confirms dark hair pixels present at y=2-12% of image. Hotspots use data-testid='hero-hotspot-{id}' and cards 'hero-hotspot-card-{id}'. Team switcher: button[data-team='ferrari|mclaren|mercedes']. ArrowDown navigates to circuit (data-testid='circuit-spatial-viewport').
rca of the issue: Previous background-removal model clipped the top of the head (braided cornrows). Main agent re-processed the PNG with a human-segmentation model and updated the aspect ratio in HeroStage.jsx LAYOUTS.ferrari.ratio to 536/1139 so the taller image renders without vertical distortion. Verified visually and by pixel sampling.
